redirect.title: Redirect Shorts
redirect.description: Send students to redirect_url instead of showing the block screen when they open a Short. Defaults to false.

redirect_url.title: Redirect address
redirect_url.description: Where to send students when redirect is true. Must be an http or https address. Defaults to https://youtube.com.

hide_shorts_in_feeds.title: Hide Shorts shelves and tabs
hide_shorts_in_feeds.description: Hide Shorts shelves on the home page and in search results, the Shorts entry in the desktop sidebar, the Shorts tab in the mobile bottom bar, and the Shorts tab on channel pages. Defaults to true.
